cookies.intro: Stockwise only uses cookies and browser local storage that are necessary for the app to work. We do not use analytics, tracking or advertising cookies, so your consent is not required.
cookies.manage: You can delete cookies and local storage in your browser settings. Your language and theme will then return to the defaults and you will be signed out.
cookies.notice: We only use necessary cookies — for sign-in, language and theme. No tracking, no ads.
cookies.purposeAuth: Keeps you signed in so you don't have to sign in on every visit.
cookies.purposeLocale: Remembers your chosen language so pages and search previews appear in your language.
cookies.purposeNotice: Remembers that you closed the cookie notice.
cookies.purposePreferences: Remembers your language and light or dark theme on this device.
cookies.thirdParty: Product photos are loaded from Cloudinary and language flags from flagcdn.com. These services receive the technical data needed to deliver content, such as your IP address. Google sign-in happens in a Google window, which is governed by Google's privacy policy.
cookies.title: Cookie policy
